requirement.statement: KWG (LOFT, LOS, ANN, ATFS), QA: in Assortment Build -> Style Review -> Style Edit - Size Concept -> Price & Cost, selecting a Ticket Price Override (e.g. 149.00) does not save. The field shows "$NaN", Final Ticket Price stays at the original Ticket Price ($160.00 for LOFT style 786335 / style color 533123), and only a lifecycleParams POST fires.
requirement.acceptance: The override saves and persists after refresh. Final Ticket Price equals the override, and returns to the Ticket Price when the override is cleared. The field shows blank (never $NaN) when no override is set. The fix survives the nightly batch. Same results in all 4 KWG brands.

prior_art.why_relevant: Previous KW pricing ticket on the same brands (Pricing mass edit / size concept). Same screens family, unrelated cause.
Documents the KW-only trigger that derives the numeric override from the _txt column and '$'-prefixes the text, and the price band trigger.

evidence.claim: The Ticket Price Override column saves into attribute:ccticketpricechannel_override_txt:id, but its dropdown options came from validValues/one?ids=ccticketpricechannel. The file is identical in all 4 brand config repos.
ccticketpricechannel_override_txt is type String; ccticketpricechannel and ccticketpricechannel_override are type Float.

darwin binds STRING columns with (String) o. A numeric option id throws ClassCastException, which is re-thrown as 'failed to cast input for column: <id> this may be a configuration issue', so the edit rolls back.

The frontend posts the selected option's id (value: option.id) to POST /api/assortment/lifecycleParams. The planningParams patch handler falls through to updateLifecycleParams, so the lifecycleParams POST is the save call.

With ids=ccticketpricechannel_override_txt the validValues call returned HTTP 500 'java.lang.NullPointerException: Tuple has null: [null, null]' from MemberBasedValidValuesFacade.loadValidValues -> IdentTuple.of.

evidence.claim: The blank option is built as ''/'' in Vertica. The export sed writes empty fields unquoted, \copy CSV loads unquoted empty as NULL, and the load repaired NULLs only for membertie.

After the line-36 config change plus a one-off NULL -> '' data fix in LOFT QA, selecting 149.00 saved the override as $149.00, Final Ticket Price went $160.00 -> $149.00, and Price Band updated to $125.00 - $150.00.

hypotheses.cause: Override is reverted by a Postgres lock/revert trigger (as in SUP-3857).
hypotheses.ruled_out_because: No lock or revert trigger touches the override columns. trg_update_cctktprc_override only derives the Float copy and '$'-prefixes the text, and it is identical in all 4 brands.

hypotheses.cause: Value never reaches the backend (no pivot3/redecorate call).
hypotheses.ruled_out_because: The lifecycleParams POST is the save call for this section. refreshSectionAfterEdit re-fetches the section instead of redecorating.
The viewdefn blob is identical in all 4 brand repos; the bug reproduces in all 4.

hypotheses.cause: Float-typed dropdown source (ids=ccticketpricechannel) feeding a String save target (ccticketpricechannel_override_txt), so darwin's String bind cast fails and the edit rolls back.
NULL blank valid-value row ('' in Vertica -> NULL in PG) makes the _txt dropdown return 500 Tuple has null.
usMoney renders an empty override as $NaN after the INT-6200 frontend change dropped the NaN guard.

root_cause.statement: Config: the Size Concept Price & Cost viewdefn loads Ticket Price Override options from the Float attribute ccticketpricechannel, but saves into the String attribute ccticketpricechannel_override_txt. The option id is posted as a number, and darwin's ColDesc.bindInput (String) cast throws, so the whole edit rolls back. Pointing the dropdown at the _txt list then exposed an ETL defect: its blank option ('' in Vertica) reaches Postgres as NULL (unquoted empty + \copy CSV), and darwin's IdentTuple rejects it with HTTP 500. "$NaN" is a separate display issue: usMoney formats the empty value, and the NaN guard was dropped by frontend commit 33d4e8f53 (INT-6200).

knowledge_gained.technical: For a Style Edit validValues column, the saved value is the option id, typed by the dataApi attribute's M_Meta type rather than the dataIndex attribute's type. A Float list feeding a String column makes darwin's ColDesc.bindInput throw 'failed to cast input for column', and the whole edit is rolled back. KW stores the override twice: ccticketpricechannel_override_txt (String, edited) and ccticketpricechannel_override (Float, derived by trg_update_cctktprc_override, which also '$'-prefixes the text). update_price_band then recomputes the price bands. <brand>_v_memberbasedvalidvalues must never hold NULL key/value (darwin IdentTuple -> 500). The Vertica->PG export turns '' into NULL, so text columns where blank matters need a post-load NULL->'' repair in daily, weekly and intraday loads.
knowledge_gained.functional: Ticket Price is the planned tag price per style color and channel. Ticket Price Override lets the planner replace it for a channel without changing the original. Final Ticket Price is the override if set, otherwise the Ticket Price. The override is restricted to approved price points (a dropdown from the brand price band lookup), and setting it moves the style color's and style's price band. If the override doesn't save, the plan keeps using the original price.
